exposure.needed: whether the environment manages CRDs separately from the Crossplane release or relies on bundled CRD installation

consequence.statement: If CRDs are managed separately from the release, the ManagedResourceDefinition CRD must be installed before upgrading; without it, the new resource type will not be available.

assertion.statement: A new CRD for ManagedResourceDefinition (managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) was added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.
